visual.general_description: Figure of three stacked treatment timelines labelled a, b and c, each with printed score boxes, treatment arrows and event annotations.
visual.detailed_description: Three horizontally oriented chevron timelines stacked vertically with printed letters a, b and c. Each has year labels at its ends, red-outlined EASI/cDLQI score boxes, colored treatment arrows (blue, orange, purple, and grey for baricitinib in c), vertical annotation arrows and a boxed list of previous treatments. Panel details are given per panel.

panels.general_description: Treatment timeline with printed EASI and cDLQI score boxes for case 1.
panels.detailed_description: Chevron timeline labelled with the panel letter a. Year labels printed at the left and right ends: 2020 and 2023. Chevron steps printed left to right: Baseline; Dupilumab started 200mg Q2W; Established on Dupilumab; Worsening , Methotrexate 0.4mg/kg added on; Abrocitinib 200mg monotherapy; Switched to Dupilumab 300mg Q2W; Dupilumab dose reduction to 200mg Q2W; Abrocitinib 200mg daily added; Established on both Abrocitinib and Dupilumab.. Colored horizontal arrows below the chevrons are labelled: blue Dupilumab arrow spanning the first part and a second blue Dupilumab arrow spanning the later part; orange Methotrexate arrow in the first part; purple Abrocitinib arrow in the middle and a second purple Abrocitinib arrow at the end. A boxed list at the lower left is titled "Previous treatment:" and lists azathioprine, cyclosporine, methotrexate, mycophenalate mofetil, phototherapy and omalizumab (printed as "mycophenalate mofetil" in the list). Vertical arrows point up from the chevron row with printed labels: "Eczema herpeticum" and "Challenging conjunctivitis" (the latter near the top edge). Red-outlined score boxes above the chevrons print: EASI: 40.1 with cDLQI: 15 (Figure 2); EASI: 9.5 with cDLQI: 3 (Figure 3); EASI: 12.5 with cDLQI: 8; EASI: 21.4; EASI: 34 (Figure 4); EASI: 9.9 with cDLQI: 6 (Figure 5).

panels.general_description: Treatment timeline with printed EASI and cDLQI score boxes for case 2.
panels.detailed_description: Chevron timeline labelled with the panel letter b. Year labels printed at the left and right ends: 2019 and 2021. Chevron steps printed left to right: Baseline; Dupilumab started 200mg Q2W; Established on Dupilumab; Worsening , Methotrexate added on; Dupilumab dose increased to 300mg Q2W; Dupilumab swapped to Abrocitinib 200mg OD; Methotrexate stopped; Dupilumab 200mg Q2W added; Established on both Abrocitinib and Dupilumab.. panels.general_description: Treatment timeline with printed EASI and cDLQI score boxes for case 3.
